title: 第九章冒进遇袭第十章逃出脱险
content_zh:
第九章冒进遇袭！
求点击，推荐，收藏，实在不行冲个咖啡也行啊！点下就行！
看着奄奄一息的青铜色僵尸，陈林当然不能放过！于是就用禁魂咒要收服这个五阶巅峰的亡灵，可是这个家伙就是不给面子！死活不肯服软！
陈林看着这个五阶巅峰的家伙，虽然长得比咋滴，不过实力却是没得说，杀了实在可惜！就在陈林还在为难要不要杀的时候，小黑也恢复了点伤势后走了过来，看着这个僵尸挥起骨刀就要杀了……
而这个五阶巅峰的僵尸竟然在这个时候，很没骨气的向小黑臣服了！而且小黑好像也会某种契约，虽然没有陈林的契约符咒厉害，可是也收服了这个五阶巅峰的青铜色僵尸！
这个结果看的陈林是目瞪口呆的，自己要收服的对象却臣服向自己的小弟！但是小黑已经收服了他，陈林也很无奈，在接下来的很长一段时间，陈林看小黑的‘眼神’都充满了幽怨！
其实陈林不知道，这个青铜色的僵尸已经拥有了低级的智慧。是不可能臣服与比自己实力还差的陈林的！至于小黑虽然实力虽然比他差，但是小黑的黑色能量攻击，让这个僵尸差点丧命使他产生了恐惧所以才向小黑臣服！
“你攻击这个家伙的那个黑球是什么技能啊！”在平静过后陈林用复杂的眼神看着小黑问道。
“是我刚刚觉悟的一个普通攻击技能”小黑弱弱的回答道，小黑他也感觉到，陈林看向自己的眼神很奇怪。而他自己也很心虚！小黑是有智慧的，所以可以对话！以后所有高级有智慧的亡灵都能对话！以后不解释了！
听完小黑的回答后，陈林直接跪了。蹲到了一边在地上画起了圈圈。浑身上下散发这无比的怨念……
陈林原本因为参悟了《太平要术》中的神通，觉得自己已经牛x的不行了，但是现在小黑的表现却狠狠的打击到了陈林。
“看来还是不能小看异界的人啊！自己虽说没有身躯很多神通不能用，可是小黑也同样是个亡灵啊！”
“小黑你的前世到底得有多强啊？……这样也太变态了！……一个普通技能就这么变态！……”陈林在怨念发完后，继续询问小黑生前的事！
小黑：“~！@#￥%……&*”无语中……
接下来陈林又接着向着更高级的区域赶去！因为又多了个五阶巅峰的帮手，所以一路下来也没什么阻碍，来到了五阶中级的区域！
陈林的实力达到了五阶高级，至于小黑更是变态直接达到了五阶初级，实力直追陈林！小黑的实力增长让陈林很震惊，感觉有种自己大哥的地位不保的感觉！
现在陈林的手下的实力是：四阶高级骷髅战士十一名；四阶中级、高级的亡灵法师各两名；四阶高级以上骷髅弓手八名；四阶巅峰的骷髅法师七名；四阶巅峰的恶灵四名名；四级巅峰的僵尸八名；还有五阶巅峰的僵尸一名！最后是已经五阶初级的小黑！
陈林手下已经有了一个不小的势力了，在清理玩周围五级高级的亡灵后，陈林决定直接向着六阶初级的区域进发！因为自己带着队伍，五阶巅峰的亡灵已经没有任何威胁了！
在亡灵界三阶升四阶还有六阶升七阶是两个大坎，这是亡灵初级升中级还有中级升高级的坎！一般的亡灵要跨越这两个坎都是难如登天！但是陈林和小黑这两个都打破了这个自然的规则！
在亡灵中除了这两个坎外还有一个重要的阶段，那就是六阶的时候！六阶是亡灵开启灵智的时期，这个时期对亡灵来说是最重要的一段时间，越早开启灵智以后的成就就会越高！反之如果六阶巅峰还没有开启灵智，那么就算以后升到高级也是枉然，最后可能被高级的亡灵驱使！

而亡灵只要开启了灵智，就会有领地和势力的意识。它们不再像以前一样只是依靠本能去厮杀，没有固定地方到处游荡。而且还会开始收服手下，并且去占领一片适合自己的地方，然后守护住自己的领地并不断的提升自己，扩大自己的领地。这个时候的亡灵生物的智慧可以说是和人类儿童没什么却别！
而小黑收服的五阶巅峰僵尸，明显已经有了低级的智慧，是一个开启灵智较早的！要不是被小黑收服，将来的成就会很高，可能会成为一方霸主！
现在陈林就打算要去的区域是六阶的区域，那里的亡灵难免会出现有智慧的亡灵，所以陈林一路上都很小心！毕竟现在陈林要面对的不在是一些傻瓜是的‘野怪’了。
但是人算不如天算，陈林一路上再小心还是遇到了麻烦！陈林他们在刚这个区域的时候，遇到了一个五阶巅峰的亡灵带领的小队，在马上就要消灭对方的时候，对方却跑了！陈林一开始以为又是一个有灵智的亡灵，没多想就直接追了过去……
在追了一段后，陈林突然发现周围太安静了，有点反常等他看向周围的时候，陈林心中一惊！陈林所在的地方是一个山谷的地形，这里除了进来的路外，两边都是上不去的峭壁，根本就是一个被包围的绝境！
“看来还是小看了亡灵的智慧啊！”陈林一阵无奈！因为他已经能感觉到自己的队伍已经被包围了！
陈林马上命令队伍停下了追击，开始慢慢的退进了队伍里面！就在陈林的队伍停止了追击后，本来空荡荡的山谷周围就出现了大量的亡灵生物！
只见周围人头攒动，没一会山谷上周围到处都涌出亡灵生物，而且还都是是拥有远程攻击的亡灵！这些亡灵的实力大都四阶高级到五阶巅峰的亡灵，有亡灵法师、骷髅法师、骷髅弓手还有恶灵！在这些亡灵之间，竟然还有零星的几个亡灵明显已经达到了六阶以上的实力！
陈林发现这些亡灵明显没有什么智慧，就是周围的六阶亡灵也都是没什么灵智！只有几个拥有了低级智慧，但是也不足以组织这次偷袭，这说明它们一定拥有一个头领。一个智力超高的头领！这个未知的头领才是最麻烦的存在！
“这次疏忽了，老子一辈子算计别人，没想到现在竟然被算计了！”陈林很无奈！
“老大，我们怎么办？现在的形式对我们很不利啊！”小黑也是感觉到了周围的危机！
“留得青山在，不怕没柴烧！我们走，硬闯出去。小心一定要活着跑出去……”陈林决定先逃出去再说！虽然这样把后背暴露给敌人，会损失很多手下，但是总比留下来全军覆没的强。
在陈林他们开始掉头逃跑的时候，周围所有的亡灵仿佛是被什么触动了似的！直接一起向着陈林的队伍发起了攻击……

Chapter 9: Rushing in and being attacked!

Looking at the dying bronze zombie, of course Chen Lin couldn't let it go! So I used the soul-forbidden curse to subdue this fifth-level peak undead, but this guy just wouldn't give me face! Refuse to give in to life and death!
Chen Lin looked at this guy at the top of the fifth level. Although he looked great, his strength was nothing to say. It would be a pity to kill him! Just when Chen Lin was still wondering whether to kill him or not, Xiao Hei came over after recovering a little from his injuries. He looked at the zombie and was about to kill it with a bone knife...
And this fifth-level peak zombie surrendered to Xiao Hei very spinelessly at this time! And Xiao Hei seems to know some kind of contract. Although it is not as powerful as Chen Lin's contract spell, he still subdued this fifth-level peak bronze zombie!
Chen Lin was stunned by this result. The person he wanted to conquer actually surrendered to his younger brother! But Xiao Hei had conquered him, and Chen Lin was helpless. For a long time, Chen Lin's eyes when he looked at Xiao Hei were full of resentment!
In fact, Chen Lin didn't know that this bronze zombie already possessed low-level wisdom. It is impossible to surrender to Chen Lin who is worse than himself! As for Xiao Hei, although his strength is inferior to him, Xiao Hei's black energy attack almost killed the zombie and made him fearful, so he surrendered to Xiao Hei!
"What's the skill of that black ball you used to attack this guy!" After calming down, Chen Lin looked at Xiao Hei with complicated eyes and asked.
"It's a normal attack skill I just realized," Xiao Hei replied weakly. Xiao Hei also felt that Chen Lin looked at him in a strange way. And he himself felt guilty! Xiao Hei is smart, so he can talk! From now on, all high-level and intelligent undead will be able to talk to each other! I won’t explain it anymore!
After hearing Xiao Hei's answer, Chen Lin knelt down directly. He squatted to the side and drew circles on the ground. This incomparable resentment spreads all over my body...
Chen Lin originally felt that he was already awesome because he understood the magical powers in "The Art of Taiping", but now Xiao Hei's performance has hit Chen Lin hard.
"It seems you shouldn't underestimate people from other worlds! Although I don't have a body and can't use many magical powers, Xiao Hei is also an undead!"
"Xiao Hei, how strong did you have to be in your previous life?... This is too perverted! ... An ordinary skill can be so perverted!..." After Chen Lin finished expressing his resentment, he continued to ask about Xiao Hei's life!
Xiaohei: "~!@#￥%...&*" Speechless...
Next, Chen Lin rushed towards a more advanced area! Because there was another helper from the fifth level peak, there was no obstacle along the way, and we arrived at the fifth level intermediate area!
Chen Lin's strength has reached the fifth level of advanced level. As for Xiao Hei, he has reached the fifth level of elementary level, and his strength is catching up with Chen Lin! Chen Lin was shocked by Xiao Hei's growth in strength and felt that his eldest brother's status was not guaranteed!
The current strength of Chen Lin's men is: eleven fourth-level senior skeleton warriors; two intermediate and advanced fourth-level necromancers each; eight senior-level and above fourth-level skeleton archers; seven peak fourth-level skeleton mages; four peak fourth-level evil spirits; eight peak fourth-level zombies; and one peak fifth-level zombie! Finally, there is Xiao Hei, who is already at the fifth level of elementary level!
Chen Lin already had a large force under his command. After cleaning up the surrounding fifth-level undead, Chen Lin decided to head directly to the sixth-level elementary area! Because he is leading the team, the undead at the peak of the fifth level no longer pose any threat!
In the world of the undead, there are two big hurdles to advance from level 3 to level 4, and from level 6 to level 7. These are the hurdles for the undead to advance from elementary level to intermediate level, and from intermediate level to advanced level! It is extremely difficult for ordinary undead to cross these two hurdles! But Chen Lin and Xiao HeiEveryone broke this natural rule!
In addition to these two hurdles, there is another important stage in the undead, and that is the sixth level! The sixth level is the period when the undead open their spiritual wisdom. This period is the most important period for the undead. The sooner they open their spiritual wisdom, the higher their achievements will be! On the other hand, if the spiritual wisdom has not been opened at the peak of the sixth level, then it will be in vain to advance to the advanced level in the future, and in the end, it may be driven by the high-level undead!
As long as the undead have opened their spiritual intelligence, they will have a sense of territory and power. They no longer just rely on instinct to fight like before, wandering around without a fixed place. And he will also start to conquer his subordinates, and occupy a place suitable for him, and then protect his territory and constantly improve himself and expand his territory. The intelligence of undead creatures at this time can be said to be the same as that of human children, but different!
The fifth-level peak zombie that Xiao Hei conquered obviously already had low-level intelligence, and he was the one who opened his spiritual intelligence earlier! If he hadn't been subdued by Xiao Hei, his future achievements would have been very high, and he might have become the overlord of one party!
The area Chen Lin plans to go to now is the sixth level area. The undead there will inevitably have intelligent undead, so Chen Lin is very careful along the way! After all, what Chen Lin has to face now is no longer some fools but 'wild monsters'.
But God's calculations are not as good as those of humans. No matter how careful Chen Lin was, he still ran into trouble! When Chen Lin and the others were in this area, they encountered a team led by a fifth-level peak undead. When they were about to eliminate the opponent, the opponent ran away! At first, Chen Lin thought it was another intelligent undead, so he chased after him without much thought...
After chasing for a while, Chen Lin suddenly found that the surroundings were too quiet and a little abnormal. When he looked around, Chen Lin was shocked! The place where Chen Lin is located is a valley. Except for the way in, there are cliffs on both sides that cannot be climbed. It is basically a desperate situation surrounded!
"It seems that I still underestimated the wisdom of the undead!" Chen Lin felt helpless! Because he can already feel that his team has been surrounded!
Chen Lin immediately ordered the team to stop the pursuit and began to slowly retreat into the team! Just after Chen Lin's team stopped chasing, a large number of undead creatures appeared around the originally empty valley!
I saw crowds of people all around, and soon undead creatures were pouring out everywhere in the valley, and they were all undead with long-range attacks! The strength of these undead is mostly from the fourth level to the fifth level peak undead, including necromancers, skeleton mages, skeleton archers and evil spirits! Among these undead, there are actually a few scattered undead that have obviously reached level six or above!
Chen Lin found that these undead obviously had no intelligence, and even the sixth-level undead around them had no intelligence! Only a few possess low-level intelligence, but they are not enough to organize this sneak attack, which shows that they must have a leader. A leader with extremely high intelligence! This unknown leader is the most troublesome existence!
"I was negligent this time. I have been plotting against others all my life, but I didn't expect to be plotted against me now!" Chen Lin was helpless!
"Boss, what should we do? The current situation is very unfavorable to us!" Xiao Hei also felt the crisis around him!
"Keep the green hills here, don't worry about running out of firewood! Let's go and break out. Be careful to escape alive..." Chen Lin decided to escape first! Although exposing your back to the enemy in this way will result in the loss of many men, it is still better than staying and being wiped out.
When Chen Lin and the others started to turn around and run away, all the undead around them seemed to be touched by something! They directly launched an attack on Chen Lin's team...
